name: Precipitation Radar
description: A radar loop over a map: soft patches of rain and snow carried along the wind frame by frame, a sweep line, play and pause, and a timeline that scrubs.

props.name: frames
props.description: How many frames the loop has.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds per frame. The sweep line turns once in this time, painting the next frame behind it.

props.name: wind
props.description: The bearing the weather comes from, in degrees, and how far it travels each frame as a share of the panel width.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the noise the precipitation is grown from. The same seed always gives the same weather.

props.name: times
props.description: A time label per frame, oldest first. Defaults to minutes before now in ten-minute steps.

props.name: height
props.description: Map panel height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start the loop when the radar comes into view. It stays still under reduced motion until play is pressed.

props.name: coverage
props.description: Roughly what share of the panel shows any echo, from 0 to 1. The strongest few percent reach heavy.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the intensity scale under the timeline.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the radar shows, for screen readers. Generated from the frame on screen when left out.

props.name: children
props.description: The base map under the precipitation, such as an image or place labels. It fills the panel.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Drawn above the rain, for place names and markers that must stay readable. Use children for the base map underneath.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the label.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts value, action and every other prop of a div.
